That's the interview. Your realm is taking shape — every answer you gave has been offered up for your review. Accept what fits, reject what doesn't. Nothing was written without your say-so.

Import my notes

Already have a campaign written up? Paste your notes in the documented format below. Everything is read on your device — no AI, no internet. Each thing you wrote becomes a candidate you review and accept; nothing is added until you say so.

The format — four kinds of heading

Start each thing with a # heading. The lines under it fill in the details (Key: value). Anything that isn't one of the four headings is listed back to you as "couldn't read" — never silently dropped, so nothing gets lost.

# Faction: The Stonemasons Guild
Type: Economic            (Government | Opposition | Religious | Economic | Military)
Position: gaining         (holding | gaining | losing | fragmenting)
Description: Controls every quarry licence in the river valley.

# NPC: Mara Veldt
Role: Guildmistress
Description: Pragmatic, owed favours by half the council.

# Location: The Lower Cisterns
Description: Flooded vaults beneath the old mint.

# Event: The Quarry Collapse
Type: Economic            (Political | Military | Economic | Social | Natural | …)
Weight: -8                (-30 to 30 — how much it shook the realm)
Visibility: public        (public | secret)
Description: A tunnel gave way, halting the eastern works.

Field names are not case-sensitive. Leave out any line you don't need — only the heading name is required. v1 reads exactly these four kinds.

Copilot
Unlock RealmWright to enable the Copilot
The Copilot — chat, session prep, NPCs, the Faction Council, and more — unlocks with a one-time product key, then runs on a free NVIDIA model or your own AI key, your choice. No key yet? The front door gives new visitors 5 free AI preview messages as an early-access taste, plus 3 fully-built Sample Realms — no key needed.
Recommended
✨ Free by NVIDIA
A genuinely capable free model, built by NVIDIA and delivered through OpenRouter — one click, free sign-in, no card. About 50 free messages a day, and it can be a little slow or busy at peak times — but there's nothing to pay and nothing to manage.
Opens a quick OpenRouter sign-in (Google works) and saves a free key for you — nothing to copy or paste.
Other options (advanced) — bring your own key, any model, or run locally
Provider
OpenRouter routes to any cloud model using your own API key — you choose the model, and you pay that provider directly for what you use (free models cost nothing). Ollama runs a model locally on your machine — completely free, and no data leaves your computer — but needs a one-time setup so the page can reach it (the Ollama fields below explain how).
Recommended: connect in one click
Authorize once in your browser and a free key comes back automatically — no copy-paste. Needs the app served over http(s); if you opened it as a downloaded file, paste a key below instead.
Or paste an API key (fallback)
Stored locally only — never sent anywhere except OpenRouter. Create a free account and API key at openrouter.ai/keys — you'll only ever pay OpenRouter for the models you choose to use.
Model
The free NVIDIA model is great for casual play but shared and slow — it can be busy and may occasionally not answer (~20 requests/minute, ~50/day; 1000/day after $10 of OpenRouter credits). Prices below are pulled live from OpenRouter and update automatically, so they're never out of date. Paid models cost a few cents per message and are faster and more reliable. New models appear here automatically too — nothing to update.
Copilot write scope
Standard allows chronicle entries, NPCs, plot seeds, and resolving hooks. Full also allows the Copilot to propose faction stance changes, nation stat deltas, and front clock ticks.
Auto-apply Copilot changes
Off by default: proposals wait in a review queue for you to accept or reject. Auto-apply lets the Copilot change your world without review — turn it on only if you trust it to act unsupervised.
Ollama base URL
Default is http://localhost:11434. If you opened this app as a downloaded file, the browser sends a "null" origin that Ollama blocks by default — start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=* ollama serve, or serve the file from a local web server.
Ollama model
Must be pulled locally first: ollama pull llama3.1. Recommended: llama3.1, mistral, or gemma3.
Cost guardrails

The meter (top-left) always shows session spend. Both fields below are opt-in — leave blank to disable. Soft warn fires once per session. Hard cap pauses AI until you resume from the meter or raise the limit here.

Warn at (USD)
One-time toast when session spend crosses this number.
Pause at (USD)
Hard cap. AI is suspended until you click resume or raise this.
Backups
Checking…
This browser has not granted persistent storage — it may clear your realm under storage pressure, without warning. Set up the on-disk backup above, or export regularly.

RealmWright lives entirely in this browser on this device — there's no account, no cloud, no sync to another device. It also auto-saves a snapshot every 24 hours (last 7 kept) so mistakes are undoable, but those snapshots share this same browser storage — they won't survive a cleared cache or a storage eviction. For that, use the on-disk backup above, or export regularly. Use "Preview restore" to see what changes before committing.
